why: The 2700-2900 band now holds two public families of equal strength: the Metav4 family (Tschinkel, Pipe-16/V54, Gluzdov) and the V5x family (Ahmed Berat Ozer V52/V53). f10_omw_lock beats the first family in every game and only ties the second (6/10, 10/6). On the consumed seeds 7511-7516 V53 + Lab lockstep scored 12/12 against v53 and v52 (+189..+531), 11/12 against gluzdov_omw and pipe16 and 9/12 against f10_omw_lock, with a modeled lockstep gain of +412 per game.
rule: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine, paired against unmodified V53 on identical opponents/seeds/seats. Gate: total paired score >= +8, mirror against V53 >= 50%, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0, no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms; then the Kaggle kernel on four fresh seeds against V5x-family opponents (the notebook must stay under 1 MB). Registered before the run.
